title: schc_session: ACK/abort authorization + tombstone hold-down + Link/L2 API
description:
Parent project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.3.7.6 (spec/03-adaptation.md 5.6, authenticated bounded Zephyr SCHC session authority). Decomposed per Yegge's rule; this is one independently landable slice. Zephyr C in lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/ + host tests in lichen/tests/. Run host CMake tests on this Linux host (Attic toolchain absent; use local gcc/clang + cmake, ASan+UBSan per tests/cmake/test_common.cmake).

SLICE 5 (terminal/control + integration seam, depends on slices 1-4): permit ACK/ACK-REQ/Sender-Abort/Receiver-Abort issuance ONLY from authenticated state transitions. Two-octet ACK-REQ vs compressed C=0 ACK ambiguity MUST be classified from the authenticated sender role + directional Rule ID BEFORE invoking an ACK decoder or mutating sender state. Receiver emits at most 4 ACK responses; a 5th otherwise-valid All-1/ACK-REQ triggers Receiver-Abort + terminal hold-down. Tombstone: on completion or authenticated abort, retain terminal outcome + session high-water + final ACK; for 60s (fragmentation inactivity interval) a repeated authenticated All-1/ACK-REQ with strictly newer counter replays the same terminal ACK/abort idempotently without starting a session; every authenticated late message in the current generation advances the tombstone high-water. After hold-down the generation-scoped high-water persists as the bounded durable admission floor. Expose the metadata/session API Link/L2 needs WITHOUT weakening existing replay/authentication and WITHOUT caller-selected authority. Unit tests: control authorization gating, ACK-REQ/ACK classification, 4-ACK-then-abort, tombstone idempotent replay within hold-down, floor persistence after expiry, atomic output/state on every error. LAND LAST; unblocks l1qw.3.7.3.
